اقتضي (form VIII)
# اُقْتُضِيَ (uqtuḍiya) /uq.tu.dˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اِقْتَضِي (iqtaḍī) /iq.ta.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
